title:
Pull out his eyes,
     Apologize,
     Apologize,
     Pull out his eyes.
 
     Apologize,
     Pull out his eyes,
     Pull out his eyes,
     Apologize.
html_source:
Notice the musicality of this.

“Pull out his eyes,
Apologize,”

It’s all in iambic dimeter, and is all quite assonant and the ends rhyme. (consider the aɪz sound in “eyes” and “-gize”)

The musical—near songlike—nature of these lines minimizes the whole concept—that telling a young child (in this instance) if he does not apologize, “the eagles will come and pull out his eyes.”
